digest.component_or_area: CI tickets-branch fetch/partial-clone in GitHub Actions and Gerrit workflows
propositions: Add filter: blob:none to every CI tickets-branch checkout and fetch path to cut transfer cost while retaining full-history and credential/ref settings.
Named-remote filter inheritance must be verified via real protocol negotiation, not mere config presence, since servers may ignore recorded partialclonefilter.
Gerrit direct-URL fetches require explicit --filter=blob:none, preserving depth-1 on require-ticket and no-depth on the verify-identity fetch.
Production guards parse size-pack from git count-objects -v and fail when unfiltered all-history exceeds the declared 102400/131072 KiB limits.
Identity scanning after materialization must add no promisor objects, asserted by unchanged before/after git count-objects -v snapshots.
tree:0 filter is forbidden because worktree materialization batch-prefetches missing promisor blobs, causing large promisor pack bloat.
